payload.reason: The evidence provides specific datasets used for evaluation in different translation tasks and image captioning.

claims.text: For English-to-German (En-De) translation, the dataset used is the WMT 2014 dataset with around 4.5 million sentence pairs, using newstest 2013 for validation and newstest 2014 for testing.
For English-to-Vietnamese (En-Vi) translation, the dataset is from IWSLT 2015, consisting of around 133K sentence pairs, with tst2012 for validation and tst2013 for testing.
For image captioning, the Microsoft COCO 2014 dataset was used, containing 123,287 images with 5 descriptive sentences each, evaluated on the MSCOCO 2014 test set.
For German-to-English (De-En) translation, the IWSLT 2014 dataset was used, with a training set of 160K sentence pairs and a test set of around 7K sentences.
